academic.passage: The concept of renewable energy is increasingly vital as the world seeks sustainable solutions to combat climate change. Renewable energy sources, such as solar, wind, and hydroelectric power, provide cleaner alternatives to fossil fuels. Unlike fossil fuels, these sources are inexhaustible and produce minimal greenhouse gas emissions. The transition to renewable energy not only helps mitigate climate change but also promotes energy security and economic growth. Governments and organizations worldwide are investing heavily in research and infrastructure to enhance the efficiency and accessibility of renewable technologies.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The need for renewable energy sources.
The financial benefits of renewable energy.
The types of renewable energy technologies.
questions.explain: 本文主要講述可再生能源的重要性和對抗氣候變化的影響。

questions.q: Which renewable energy sources are mentioned?
questions.explain: 文中提到的可再生能源來源包括太陽能、風能和水電。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the future of renewable energy?
options: It will be further developed and utilized.
It will replace all fossil fuels immediately.
It has no effect on climate change.
questions.explain: 可以推斷可再生能源將繼續發展並被更廣泛地利用。

questions.q: What does 'inexhaustible' mean in the context of renewable energy?
questions.explain: 在可再生能源的上下文中，'無窮'是指這些資源是取之不盡的。

daily.passage: Attention students! The campus library will be undergoing renovations starting next week. During this time, certain areas will be closed off for construction. Please check the library's website for updates on available services and resources. Thank you for your understanding!

questions.q: When will the library renovations start?
questions.explain: 圖書館的翻修將於下週開始。

questions.q: What should students do for updates about the library?
questions.explain: 學生應查看圖書館的網站以獲取更新。
